protocol.name: lapin_shell_v1
protocol.description: Small additions the Lapin UX shell needs from the compositor: placing a window in a fraction of the work area (snap layouts) and hearing when a window wants attention (taskbar flashing). Windows are named by the identifier of their ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.

request.name: snap

description.summary: place a window in part of the work area

request.description: Float the window and place it in the given part of the work area of its monitor (panels excluded), in ten-thousandths of the area's width and height. Gaps are applied by the compositor.

event.name: attention
event.description: Sent when a window asks to be activated but isn't given the focus.

request.name: peek

description.summary: look through the windows at the desktop

request.description: While enabled, windows aren't drawn: only the wallpaper, desktop and panels are visible (taskbar "Show desktop" hover).

request.name: night_light
request.description: Tint every output towards the given colour temperature in kelvin (1200 to 6500). 0 turns night light off.

event.name: gesture

description.summary: a touchpad swipe the shell handles

event.description: Sent once per swipe, when its direction is known, for three-finger swipes and four-finger swipes the compositor doesn't use itself.

event.name: alt

description.summary: an Alt key went down or up

event.description: Sent whenever an Alt key is pressed or released, whichever surface has the keyboard (pressed: 1 down, 0 up). The shell's Alt+Tab switcher uses it: a surface that gets the keyboard while Alt is already down can't tell reliably from its own keyboard events, and a quick tap can be over before the switcher exists.
